fusions.name: Rebuff
fusions.desc: A heavy shove that deals 12 damage, up to 1.5 times as much at its maximum range of 4 tiles, and knocks the target back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Bulwark Crush
fusions.desc: Brings the full weight down on every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 28 damage and ignoring resistances.

fusions.name: Hold the Line
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 28 damage and holds for 10 seconds. Your armour rises 10% while it holds.

fusions.name: Held Ground
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 8% of your maximum health per stack (64% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds. It also hardens your armour by 6% at all times.
